answer: Give each identity a 50-unit bond and a six-epoch probation. In every epoch it must complete one randomly assigned task and receive three attestations from peers with no shared recent contacts; a duplicate fingerprint or synchronized submission freezes the bond for two epochs. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, peer independence, and timing windows. Each extra sybil therefore locks another 50 units and repeats six rounds, while a ledge of identical behavior exposes the cluster; terrace reviewers and reef-linked audits preserve honest records.
